titel: EU aluminium sector – trade measure to ensure sufficient availability of aluminium scrap on the EU market
titel_en: EU aluminium sector – trade measure to ensure sufficient availability of aluminium scrap on the EU market
samenvatting: The initiative is aimed to address the problem of insufficient availability and affordability of secondary raw materials for the aluminium sector. The proposal implements the Commission’s commitment to consider trade measures on exports of aluminium scrap as stated in the Steel and Metals Action Plan adopted in March 2025.
